ABOUT FABINT

We want the story
behind a product to be checkable.

We are three RMIT architecture students building a curated product marketplace. Our starting question is simple: what would a buyer need to see to trust both the object and the maker?

OUR PURPOSE

Make good products easier to understand and choose.

Beautiful imagery can start interest. Clear specifications, source links and an honest account of uncertainty help people decide.

01 / CURATE

Start with distinctive products.

We plan to bring together high-end products with useful design, material and maker stories.

02 / CHECK

Show our research.

Our FI Verify method records public evidence about a maker, certificate checks and a human-approved verdict.

03 / LEARN

Improve with real use.

We will seek buyer feedback as the marketplace opens, while keeping early scores clearly provisional.

WHERE WE ARE TODAY

The framework comes first.

The shop and maker directory are being prepared. We have not published a product or an approved maker report on this site yet.

Why this order matters.
Product details, public sources and review status need to be connected before any listing can honestly carry an FI Score. We will publish those fields together when the first records are approved.
